t: Command picture hanging strips offer a damage-free solution for hanging picture frames, wall art, small mirrors, clocks, signs, whiteboards, and other home decor. Suitable for indoor use only, these strips adhere to a variety of smooth surfaces including painted walls, finished wood, painted concrete cinder blocks, laminate, glass, metal, and tiles. They hold strongly without the need for nails, screws or tools, and can be removed cleanly without leaving holes, marks or sticky residue. The strips lock together to securely hold items in place and allow for easy removal and repositioning when needed. Weight capacity: 2 pairs of strips hold up to 2.5kg, 4 pairs of strips hold up to 5kg.
